hypothesis: Direct synchronous calls transfer Bytes ownership and borrow BytesView without lifetime syntax, payload copies, extra allocation, reference counting, or ambiguous ownership.
competing_explanation_1: Descriptor copies or optimizer inlining can hide a duplicated owner or payload copy.
competing_explanation_2: A memory-bound call-heavy workload can hide an expensive ABI or retain/release traffic.
falsifier: Any borrowed escape, hidden copy/allocation/RC, lost or duplicate owner, sanitizer defect, ambiguous HIR/MIR relation, valid<320, invalid<220, performance>1.10x best equivalent arm, or full-suite failure.
minimal_change: Add only direct synchronous Bytes owned-transfer and BytesView call-scoped borrow lowering plus versioned evidence extensions.
required_evidence: surface/HIR/MIR/native differential corpus, negative ownership fixtures, ASan/UBSan/LSan, no-inline ABI controls, structural counters, call-heavy three-arm timing, full suite, frozen hashes.
stop_condition: Stop on confirmed safety defect; otherwise select one preregistered status after one Decision Run.
